text_block_list.text:
The visitor burst into the waiting room
just before the Takarazuka Kinen,
practically tumbling inside—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-A-Aaaayaaabe-shaaan!!
(Patter-patter-patter-patter-pat!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto... did you, right before the race...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "...Are you okay? Did you hurt yourself anywhere?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! I'm otay...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: By myself... um... I can stand on my own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, um... yes.
...Um, um, um, um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Ayabe-san...
As I thought... you really are so cool."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool. You're always so sharp, so incredibly earnest, stoic...
and strong.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking how amazing you are, and how nice that must be...
...Since I'm always just thinking things like that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I just... don't have any confidence. I've always, always been clumsy, slow, completely useless at everything I do, and yet I'm such a sore loser.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm such a sore loser, I just keep trying without learning my lesson... and failing.
Failing, failing, failing...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I hate this," I thought for the longest time.
"I hate this, I want to change."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I also... Even someone like me――

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That she wants to be like Opera O-san.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be, but I couldn't.
Not at all, not even close, but still—!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Even so, I just can't bring myself to give up...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"And then... Opera O-san
called my name."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
After the Tenno Sho (Spring), I knew: It's me.
They were waiting for me, only me, truly me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-B-But... like I said!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Today...! I'm... I'm going to defeat Ayabe-san—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I, I, I will!
I'll show you that I can become
Opera O-san's rival!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh, absolutely not!!
—Meisho Doto's long confession.

"Admire Vega listened to the end in total silence,
before finally declaring with absolute conviction:"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—Hate to ruin the mood,
but I don't recall ever agreeing to be part of
that ridiculous Opera O's grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So, feel free to pursue the role of a rival if that's what you desire.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Still, I won't give up victory in the race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen, where the chosen ones gather.
After all, it's the crown of the Spring Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —It'll definitely be something to boast about.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I won't yield. I will win.
It's as simple as that."

Carrying each of their hopes—
The time to race draws near.
